theorems.name: Submission.imc_mlb_exists_form_lintegral_coordNorm_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (κ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k) (R : ℝ), (∀ γ : SimonMultiIndex k N, IntegrableOn (fun x => euclideanNVectorCoordinate (κ x) γ) (ball (0 : Eucl N) R) μ) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ω : Eucl N → Covector (Eucl N) k, Continuous ω ∧ tsupport ω ⊆ ball (0 : Eucl N) R ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) ∧ Integrable (fun x => κ x (ω x)) μ ∧ ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Eucl N) R, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (∑ γ : SimonMultiIndex k N, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate (κ x) γ) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, κ x (ω x) ∂μ + ε)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
